immutable_ref_policy: Candidates receive proof credit only at full immutable revisions with source identities and locally checkable dependency closure. Moving heads and dated index responses are discovery evidence only.
credentials_policy: Anonymous public HTTP only; authenticated GitHub code search was unavailable.
network_policy: Public metadata and immutable raw/tree inspection only; no dependency clone, dependency fetch, Lake update, Lake build, checkout, or .lake mutation.
search_order: manifest-pinned mathlib and every materialized dependency source
official or primary Lean 4 formalization projects
other public Lean repositories at immutable revisions
historical Lean versions and other provers as uncredited research evidence
human proof sources for later obligation work
namespace_and_declaration_queries: forall n : Nat, 5 < n -> Odd n -> exists p q r : Nat
Nat.Prime p and Nat.Prime q and Nat.Prime r
surfaces: all tracked repository-local Lean files via ripgrep
all manifest-materialized package Lean sources via ripgrep
Sourcegraph public Lean index with archives and forks included
GitHub code search with explicit authentication-failure handling
google-deepmind/formal-conjectures complete recursive tree at an immutable revision
AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd complete recursive tree and Goldbach module at an immutable revision
lengyijun/goldbach_tm complete recursive tree and relevant source modules at an immutable revision
GitHub Goldbach-plus-Lean repository metadata query followed by an immutable foolishair/Goldbach source archive audit
expected_negative_evidence: Every bounded query records exact terms, a response or source hash, and either a completion boundary or an explicit access/result-limit failure. Zero matches are never promoted to an internet-wide absence claim.
negative_evidence_policy: No global absence or discovery-saturation claim is made. The broad Goldbach Sourcegraph query hit a 100-result limit; GitHub code search required authentication; grep.app returned a security checkpoint.
append_only_policy: A new discovery creates a successor inventory version; it does not erase this bounded audit.
